title: Japan Ke 3 Paise Wale Tarike
note:
METHOD TWO — HARA HACHI BU. The chapter has ONE mechanism and it is held
     across three consecutive B scenes, exactly as ch2 holds B across 37.8 ->
     about 1% -> thirty times: ten cells, eight of them, then the last two
     leaving. The layout never moves; only what the cells are doing changes.
     s51 breaks the run and hands the same ratio to the measure bar in rupees.

     Ground arc: warm on an old habit -> neutral as the rule is stated -> cool
     on why it works -> green through the two scenes that are an instruction ->
     red at month-end zero -> amber on Japan's own 62.2% -> neutral -> green at
     the ₹1,500 floor -> amber on the entry ticket -> the chapter's hottest red
     on the honest caveat -> warm out.

     Archetypes: A B B B A A B A B A A A.

     coastal path. The footnote is a disclaimer, so nothing drawn may imply a
     figure here.

s51.comment:
5.5 · A · PLATE · fund · green — the run of B breaks and the same ratio
     arrives in rupees. The measure bar is the ten cells restated as one length,
     which is why it fills to exactly 0.20 and stops.

s52.comment:
5.6 · A · PLATE · warn · red — DAY ONE, NOT DAY THIRTY. An empty wallet
     already says zero; a draining bar over it would only say it twice.

s53.comment:
5.7 · B · FIGURE · target · amber — 62.2%, Japan's own consumption figure.
     Lit windows at dusk. Art off: the figure is the subject and the citation
     under it is doing the work.

s54.comment:
5.8 · A · PLATE · no role · neutral — NOT DISCIPLINE. A wall switch in the
     ON position: one decision carrying twenty-nine days, photographed.

s55.comment:
5.9 · B · FIGURE · fund · green — ₹1,500, the floor. Two coins side by side;
     the figure is the whole scene.

s56.comment:
5.10 · A · PLATE · target · amber — THE ENTRY TICKET. Price evidence, never
     a recommendation, so nothing drawn may rank or endorse.

s57.comment:
5.11 · A · PLATE · warn · red hot — HONESTLY. The chapter's hottest ground
     and its most important line: a long empty road under the admission that
     this fails in month one for some viewers.

s58.comment:
5.12 · A · PLATE · target · warm — THEN THE QUESTION CHANGES. A cracked
     ledger spine, handing to KAKEIBO.
